page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number top left. One main text block of chronological table columns: narrative text column in the centre-right with ruled columns of numbers to its left and right (dates, years, regnal numbers, ages), and marginal year numbers at the far right edge. A small marginal label at far left, outside the table. No other blocks.

page.notes: Left margin label, small and illegible at this scan ("Gothorum Regum").
